rules: Use 'Playfair Display' for main headings to give a premium, cultural feel.
Use 'Dancing Script' for the word 'Party' to match the golden brush-script requirement.
Never use Inter for headings. Use tight letter spacing for headings.
Body text should be readable geometric sans (Outfit).
Base background for hero must be a bright blue sky gradient.
Use warm gold and orange for typography and accents.
Section backgrounds should be a warm cream to keep it festive and not dark/club.
Never use pure black; use deep blue or slate-900 instead.

surfaces: Glassmorphism for floating nav or sticky CTA: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border border-white/40 shadow-lg.
Cards: Flat cream or white backgrounds with warm golden borders and subtle soft shadows.
decorations: Use absolute positioned images of palm leaves at the edges of the hero section to frame it.
Add traditional motifs using Lucide icons: Flower2 (Pookalam), VenetianMask (Kathakali), Sailboat (Houseboat), Flame (Oil Lamp), Leaf (Banana leaves).

custom: Sticky Bottom 'Book Now' bar for mobile

grids.bento: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-8 to 12 for the Highlights section.
grids.cards: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-8 for Lineup and Tickets.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use py-20 or py-24 for sections. Use p-6 or p-8 for cards.
layouts.hero: min-h-screen relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-center items-center text-center
layouts.sticky_cta: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-4 z-50 md:hidden bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-orange-100

rules: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered entrance animations (fade up).
Hover states on all interactive elements (lift up -translate-y-1, shadow increase).
Ensure sufficient contrast for white text on sky blue backgrounds. Use subtle text-shadow if needed.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
Use proper heading hierarchy (H1 -> H2 -> H3).
Images should not exceed 80vh on mobile.
Use object-cover and rounded corners for photos.
Hero palm leaves should be placed using absolute positioning with z-index behind text.

3d_libraries.reason: Used for the 'One Vibe. Our People. Endless Memories.' tagline ribbon. No heavy 3D needed to maintain fast loading and festive feel.

hero_palm_leaves.description: Lush green palm trees to be used as framing edges in the hero section.

palm_leaves_alt.description: Alternative palm fronds for framing or background textures.

kerala_band.description: Vibrant outdoor live band to represent the Kerala Band.

dj_night.description: Vibrant concert DJ scene for the DJ Night featuring.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Playfair Display, Dancing Script, Outfit.
Do NOT use placeholder images. ONLY use the provided image URLs.
For traditional motifs (pookalam, kathakali, etc.), use Lucide icons creatively (e.g., Flower2, VenetianMask, Sailboat, Flame, Leaf) inside golden circular containers.
Ensure the hero has a 3D headline effect for 'ONAM' using text-shadows (e.g., text-white drop-shadow-xl) and 'Party' in Dancing Script below it.
Build a sticky bottom 'Book Now' bar that only shows on mobile, while desktop has the CTA in the nav or hero.
Create the ticket booking flow using Shadcn Dialog/Modal. Include a simple mock form for Early Bird and General tickets.
Include an Admin panel route (e.g., /admin) with a simple Shadcn Table for booking management.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container in global CSS.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Add data-testid to all interactive elements for robust automated testing.
